manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0109; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘No, it isn't here yet.’ and ‘He isn't here yet either.’ are natural short spoken uses of temporal yet.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps yet to «هنوز/تا این لحظه» without changing the target sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast time meanings and unrelated target candidates without random noise.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Responses are short and controlled for A1; either adds only a small transfer burden.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second use shifts from the bus to the driver while preserving the same temporal meaning.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, turns and final retrieval all align to one bounded sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
